summary: Upload a CSV, Excel or Parquet table and keep it as it is: the original file, the reading choices and the column declarations you made; nothing is mapped to wells unless you choose it.
redistribution: Ophiolite source in this repository; Excel and Parquet files are read with openpyxl (MIT), xlrd (BSD) and pyarrow (Apache-2.0), installed with the server.

losses: Text formatting is kept only in the exact original
Text formatting is kept only in the exact original
Formulas are kept only in the exact original; the table holds their stored values
Cell styles, merged cells and other sheets are kept only in the exact original
unsupported: more than one sheet in one table

losses: Columns of nested or unsupported types are listed as not read and kept only in the exact original
unsupported: nested types (list, struct, map) as columns
